data.name: Rinai Vero
data.title: Director of Operations, Luminaire Generalissmo
data.description:
I've never trusted the Caldari State, and I never will. I don't think I can ever forgive them for following Heth down his insane path to war. Even now, years after his regime collapsed, they have no interest in seeking peace. The Intaki tried appeasing them, and look what it got them. Monastaries in flames. Children maimed and killed by Lai Dai mines even after we chased them out of the system.

Our choice now must be to bring the megacorporate oligarchs to their knees. There is no price in Caldari blood that they are unwilling to pay to maintain their power, and the cost to the Federation to bring this war to a final end will be terrible beyond reckoning. But it must be done.

Excerpt: Personal Log; Rinai Vero

About
Aideron Robotics is a Faction Warfare corporation fighting for the Gallente Militia, one of the older corporations in GalMil and well known for mature and respectful gameplay,
Aideron Robotics caters to pilots in all time zones but primarily USTZ. Based in the low-sec warzone, Aideron Robotics welcomes pilots of all skill levels. With a mix of new and veteran pilots, we are a perfect corp for pilots new to PvP and alpha clone pilots, as well as experienced mature pilots keen to help train and develop others. With close ties to the rest of the Gallente Militia, Aideron Robotics pilots are always welcomed in PvP fleets militia-wide, providing an expansive range of gameplay and experiences.

Doctrine fits start with a basic three-day program that lets brand new pilots fly in AIDER fleets quickly.

While we are fundamentally a PvP corp, we also offer guidance on profitable industry and planetary interaction programs as alternative income sources, and engage in PvE to help keep things fresh.

What do we do
Small gang PvP
Specialized in Plex Warfare

data.name: Sons of Luminaire
data.description:
The Sons of Luminaire are a pirate and terrorist organisation operating in the interests of the Gallente Federation, and wanted for crimes against the Caldari State, Minmatar Republic and Amarr Empire including: piracy, terrorism, sabotage, espionage, and the wilful and continued destruction of both civilian and Naval assets and infrastructure.

CONCORD advises civilian and Naval assets to only engage with overwhelming force and to disengage in all other cases.

- CONCORD Security Directive, YC121 30.03

The State calls you, capsuleer, for it needs your strength and your leadership to fend off the encroaching Gallente menace. The State will not fall. Join us. Fight. Conquer.

data.name: The Frog Pond
data.description:
The Frog Pond is a premier Faction Warfare training corporation led by Gallente militia veterans. Our goal is to arm you with both the ships and the knowledge to make an impact on the battlefields of New Eden from day one.

We offer:

- Leadership made of Gallente militia veterans who know all the ins and outs of the Faction Warfare
- Curated fittings and skill training plans
- Free ships that you can use both solo and for fleet content
- Experienced Fleet Commanders who will show you the ropes
- Guides covering various topics ranging from basics of combat to making money to sustain your career
- Support of various GalMil groups - you will be free to use existing infrastructure of the established alliances
- Low tax rates that do not impact your source of income while allowing us to provide free ships

Hop onto our Discord server to learn how to join our ranks!
